description: Hi! I'm Vaishnavi, a third-year B.Tech Computer Science student passionate about AI/ML, software development and innovation. I enjoy building practical solutions and exploring emerging technologies. I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates interested in Python, AI/ML, web development, data science, GIS, satellite data or UI/UX. Beginners are welcome! I value creativity, teamwork, commitment and problem-solving. Let's collaborate, learn and build an impactful solution for NASA Space Apps Challenge
